description:
Ask a number of people to choose between 2 to 6 options, and pay each one. The cost is respondentCount times (pay plus 18% of pay, rounded), taken from your wallet in this call.
Use for: a vote or taste test. If funds are short, the saved run starts automatically after funding. Send an idempotencyKey to reuse the first run and ignore new input. Unkeyed retries may charge again.
Not for: adding money to your wallet (fund_wallet); finding a run you started earlier (list_taste_runs).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: create_taste_run({"question":"Which logo feels more trustworthy, and why?","options":[{"label":"Blue","url":"https://example.com/logo-blue.png"},{"label":"Green","url":"https://example.com/logo-green.png"}],"respondentCount":10,"payPerRespondent":{"amount":100,"currency":"usd"}})
Repeat: A repeat may act again on the thing as it stands then. Read it first.
Errors: spending_limit_reached, run_not_funded, account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

acceptAllApplicants.description: Accept every eligible applicant automatically instead of vetting creative fit. Eligibility checks and your country/gender restrictions still apply.

allowedCountries.description: an array of at most 30 item(s)

allowedGenders.description: Optional allowlist of self-declared profile genders. Omit for no gender restriction.

autoMode.description: Defaults to true. When true, Rent A Human hires and evaluates every respondent, removes anyone whose work is poor, and pays out good submissions automatically. Set false to have every hiring and payout decision escalated to you instead.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

identityRequired.description: Require respondents to pass the account-level government ID check before applying.

options.description: The 2 to 6 things people choose between, each a label and an http(s) link. Labels must differ.

url.description: a string at most 2048 character(s) long

payPerRespondent.description: Pay per person: at least 50 cents, or 10 for quickVote. Total worker pay must reach 100 cents; including our 18% fee, the run cannot exceed $2,000.

quickVote.description: true: people tap one of exactly two image options and give no reason. Needs voteMode instant and no video or portfolio. Default false.

requirePortfolioUpload.description: Require each respondent to upload a portfolio sample with their application.

requireVideoResponse.description: Require each respondent to attach a recorded video response with their vote.

respondentCount.description: a number less than or equal to 100

targetCategories.description: Creative categories of respondents to target; omit for no category restriction.

voteMode.description: Defaults to instant. Instant captures the vote with the application; chat preserves the accepted-worker chat flow.

name: create_taste_run

cost.description: What the run took from your wallet, on the first call when isRepeat is true. 0 while it waits for money.

isRepeat.description: true when this answers for a run an earlier call already started; nothing was taken now. Left out otherwise.

status.description: collecting: paid for and open to people. blocked_awaiting_funds: saved, waiting for money; see waitingFor. reviewing and closed come back only on a repeat.

waitingFor.description: Set while the run waits for money. It starts by itself once the wallet covers `needed`; nothing more to call. It ends unstarted after 7 days. Left out otherwise.

needed.description: The whole cost of the run, fee included.

reason.description: wallet_short: add money with fund_wallet. other: a check on our side; it retries by itself.

title: Ask people to choose
